title: Jet Boating Montreal's Lachine Rapids
includes: Life jacket, changing rooms, safe lockers, ponchos
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The boat ride lasts one hour. You are required to arrive 45 minutes prior to the departure time for orientation. Anticipate 15 minutes after the activity to change.
This is a wet trip. Bring a change of clothes or bathing suit. Secure lockers are included in the price.
Sandals are included. We do recommend bringing your own sandals/crocs/footwear for comfort.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Montreal’s Ultimate Jet Boating Adventure!

Experience the thrill of jet boating on the St. Lawrence River — the perfect blend of excitement and fun for all ages! Whether you crave more exhilarating action at the front or a gentler, family-friendly ride at the back, this adventure offers something for everyone. Get ready to get wet and make memories you won’t forget!

See Iconic Montreal Landmarks:
Enjoy stunning views of the Montreal Casino, Victoria Bridge, and the Clock Tower as you zip along the river.

Safety & Comfort Included:
We’ve got you covered with life jackets, ponchos, and secure lockers, so you can focus on the fun. Just bring your bathing suit and a sense of adventure!

A Ride to Remember:
Laugh, splash, and soak in the sights — this is a journey that’s as thrilling as it is unforgettable.

Book now for an incredible water adventure that will leave you wanting more!

***Guests must arrive 45 minutes prior to departure time***
